title: Entangled Parts
subtitle: Ingots, wire and coils
text:
Entangled parts start with the Entangled Ingot, alloyed from a Redstone Copper Ingot and an Ender Pearl in the Alloy Smelter. The Rolling Mill in rod mode turns each ingot into 2 Entangled Wire.

Four wire wound on a steel rod make an Entangled Coil. Coils go into every buffer, tank, relay and pad assembly, the backpack and the Chunk Loader Module. The ingot and wire also build the Programmer and Link Cards.
caption: Ingot to wire to coil

steps.note:
Alloy Smelter
1x Redstone Copper Ingot, 1x Ender Pearl

Rolling Mill, rod mode
1x Entangled Ingot

Crafting Table
4x Entangled Wire, 1x Steel Rod
